turns.clarify: Agent had proposed hand-building with the solver demoted to verification, reading the v11-v13 failures as solver failures. Corrected on challenge: those were objective/constraint design failures - symmetric rmse trades feature distinctness for area, and v13's valley floors were infeasible with cuts-only bands. Revised division: agent fixes structure (band count, centres, signs) from the terrain; solver sizes gains and Qs inside it under flush constraints; composite still checked by eye.

diagnosis.method: Fresh terrain probes at 1/6 and 1/12 oct with a 1/12 terrain-only plot read by eye, then a refine over six seeded treble bands above the three untouched non-treble bands against a two-sided rmse_erb objective at 1/12 oct, under flush constraints pinning residual near zero at every feature and every valley, with the composite plotted vs terrain and read by eye (jobs ori3-v17-terrain-probe.json, -terrain-probe12.json, -terrain-plot12.json, -refine.json, -plot.json).
diagnosis.finding: Probe corrections to ledger prose: at 1/6 oct the 5-9k region is a monotone ramp (every slice max at its upper edge) - the 5.9k/6.8k humps resolve only at 1/12 (+2.8 at 5.71k, +4.1 at 6.74k, +4.5 shoulder at 7.58k, apex +6.3 at 8.18k); the brief's '+2.9 tip at 11.5k' was stale DF-era at 1/6 but a real +2.6 narrow peak at 11.64k exists at 1/12; 4k dip deeper than prose (-3.7 at 3.87k); sag -2.2..-2.5 across 9.4-10.6k is broad, not a null; spike twin-topped +5.6/+6.9 at 15.58/16.09k; canyon -13.2 at 12.3k. Refine converged 2.44 -> 1.18; feature residuals 8.2k +0.40, 6.8k +0.04, 5.7k +0.36, sag +0.28, 11.6k +0.53, spike zone +1.15. Deliberate pins: both -6.0 gains at the per-turn clamp, Q 5.9 at the Blackwood exemplar max; solver pinned 5790 shallow at -1.0 (7k skirt serves most of the hump) and the sag lift at its +4.0 bound.
diagnosis.explains_symptom: First fit of the session with sign alternation: cut bed + narrow apex carver + sag lift + narrow 11.6k cut + spike cut. The lift is what every rejected cuts-only fit lacked - it holds the 9-12k air up and keeps the minima distinct. Own-eyes plot check: response is a recognizable flipped copy of the terrain, residual within +/-1 dB from 5k to 12k, no merged bowls.
diagnosis.confidence_flags: All bands above 8 kHz carry the above-qualified-range caveat; ear adjudicates final scale.
